body:
**v0.1.0** - jake-studio: source tree for the L10 harness (certainty, cognition, nocturne, agent factory modules) plus a Builder/Verifier example.

- packages/l10 holds the Python modules and tests; packages/operator has loader scripts.
- examples/closed-loop-builder-verifier documents the pattern with a cap of 3 feedback rounds.
- Docs include the public boundary and a video script.
- Smoke test: cd packages/l10 && python3 -m compileall -q src (a compile check only).
name: v0.1.0
